observations: White front-loading washing machine with Samsung branding visible on the top left of the control panel in both photos.
Control panel includes a central dial, digital display, and buttons for power and start/pause.
Model label 'ecoBubble 7.0kg' is visible on the lower right of the control panel in both photos.
A blue sticker with 'Digital Inverter' and '10 Year Warranty' is present on the lower right of the front panel.
The machine is in a cluttered, possibly outdoor or workshop environment with debris and other appliances nearby.
The door has a small transparent window and a white handle.
No visible damage to the exterior casing, but the machine appears used with some dirt and wear.
No dryer compartment or separate drying function is visible in the photos.
The seller claims it is a 'washing machine and spin with dryer', but no drying mechanism or vent is visible.

claims.claim: Washing machine and spin with dryer
claims.evidence: The photos show only a front-loading washing machine with no visible dryer compartment, vent, or drying function. The 'spin' function is standard for washing machines, but the 'dryer' claim cannot be confirmed from the photos.

risks.risk: The machine may not have a drying function as claimed.
risks.proof: A photo showing the interior or rear of the machine, or a video demonstrating the drying cycle, or a clear label indicating 'washer-dryer' or 'combo' model.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a standard washing machine without dryer, which reduces value significantly.

risks.risk: The machine may be non-functional or have hidden mechanical issues.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine running through a full wash cycle, including spin, or a demonstration of the control panel responding to inputs.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working, which reduces value to scrap or parts.

risks.risk: The machine may have water or electrical damage not visible from the exterior.
risks.proof: A photo or video of the interior drum, or a demonstration of water drainage and filling.
risks.if_unproven: priced with a discount for potential hidden damage.

proof_requests: A photo or video showing the interior of the machine or the back panel to confirm if it is a washer-dryer combo.
A video demonstrating the machine running through a full wash and spin cycle.
A photo of the model number plate or any label indicating 'washer-dryer' or 'combo' functionality.
A photo of the machine's power cord and plug to confirm it is intact and compatible with Nigerian outlets.
response.reason: The seller claims the machine has a dryer function, but the photos show only a standard front-loading washing machine with no visible drying mechanism. Without proof of the dryer function, the item cannot be priced as a washer-dryer combo. The machine's functionality and condition also require verification to avoid pricing it as working when it may not be.
